column1: # Calibration benchmark of atommapper.calibrate: calls of map_atoms on pairs of molecules.
# Synthetic: every molecule was put together from building blocks by
# benchmarks/make_calibration_pairs.py (seed 20261118); none comes from a database.
# 300 calls, about 50 in each of six bands of the pair's heavy atoms
# (up to 50, 70, 90, 120, 200 and above), smallest pairs first.
# Columns: source SMILES, target SMILES, allow_stereo_inversion (0 or 1).
